hook_text: A golden rhinoceros, the length of a pencil, buried with a king eight hundred years ago.
clip_script: Mapungubwe, Limpopo. Up a steep staircase to the top of a hill, where kings once lived, looking out over two rivers and three countries. About eight hundred years ago, this was the capital of a rich African kingdom. In 1933, royal graves on the hill revealed gold: a bowl, a sceptre, thousands of beads, and a little golden rhinoceros with one horn. Mapungubwe traded gold and ivory across the Indian Ocean, even with China.
visual_style: Whiteboard hilltop with royal houses above and village below, a golden rhino glinting, then trade routes across the Indian Ocean.
mood: Proud and majestic, like uncovering royal treasure.
pacing: Climb the hill, reveal the gold, then sail the trade routes.
